name: comp-16
title: Currency Amount Input
blurb: Currency field with symbol prefix and code suffix.
description: A text input framed by a currency symbol (€) on the left and currency code (EUR) on the right. No validation or formatting logic included.
use_when: A form needs a currency input that signals the money type visually without adding complexity.
avoid_when: You need automatic formatting (grouping, decimal places) or multi-currency selection.
a11y: Has label with htmlFor binding, but no error states or required-field indicators. Static layout.
